expectation: Nuclear RB in nucleated cells. In colon, expect nuclei in the crypt epithelium lining the mucosa, highest in proliferating zones, with a sparse stromal and endothelial minority. Expect discrete nuclear-sized dots on a dark background.
observed: A: yellow haze fills the whole field, off-tissue too, with round bright debris blobs. A thin brighter rim follows the epithelial lining in the same places on both tissue copies. B and C: diffuse haze, no discrete nuclei. D: a few blurry, cell-sized bright clumps.
why: A reproducible epithelium-following rim hints at a real low-contrast signal, but haze and debris dominate and B–D show no clear nuclear population.
